title: Weight-space programming and mechanistic interpretability for model editing in particle physics
read_level: full (arXiv HTML: main text Secs 1-5, Appendix B/C read; Appendix D tables skimmed)
why_wsp: Claude Opus 5.5 agents (via Claude Code) edit body/classifier weights of the OmniLearned jet foundation model using closed-form computations and at most 50 evaluation queries, with no gradients or iterative optimization, to remove an infrared-sensitivity flaw; compared with SAE-guided latent removal and fine-tuning.
domain: particle physics: jet tagging foundation model (infrared safety)
editor: Claude Opus 5.5 through Claude Code agent v2.1.316
interface: code/tensor tools (closed-form computations on weights/activations; evaluation tool returning outputs, activations, or edit scores)
loop: closed-loop with feedback (up to 50 evaluation queries per run)
fraction_or_count_of_weights_changed: selected WSP median 10,122 changed parameters, range [142, 10 267] (Table 1); 'for the large model, its edits reach up to 400\,000 parameters' (Sec 3.3); fine-tuning 63,240; SAE edit 1,533 (Table 2)

headline_results.claim: Flaw: one soft photon drops W efficiency 80% -> 54%
headline_results.quote: Adding one photon with f=10^{-3} lowers the W efficiency of this selection from 80% to 54% and the QCD acceptance from 2.0% to 0.7%
All three approaches bring back this efficiency between 78% to 79% while the efficiency of the original model falls from 80% to 54%.

headline_results.claim: WSP preserves physical response best; fewer parameters than fine-tuning
headline_results.quote: It keeps the response to physical changes within 1% of the original, against 0.90 for fine-tuning and 0.78 for the SAE edit. It changes about 10,000 parameters, six times fewer than fine-tuning.

headline_results.claim: More information to agent improves repair (remaining error 0.33 vs 0.12 vs 0.08)
headline_results.quote: The remaining error of the least informed agents is 0.33, against 0.12 and 0.08 for the two other variants, and the ranges do not overlap.
In the model repaired by WSP they stay between 78% and 80% for all nine taggers.

headline_results.claim: New regression head on repaired backbone no longer reacts to sub-threshold photon
headline_results.quote: On the models repaired by WSP and SAE edits, the prediction changes less ( 1.1 GeV ) than for a control photon of 3 GeV

headline_results.claim: Larger models: selected variant remaining error
headline_results.quote: for the selected variant, the remaining error is 0.04 and 0.10, and the flaw informed agents again repair less, with 0.23 and 0.32.

cost.quote: each run allows up to 50 queries to an evaluation tool

baselines_and_controls: Original model, input removal rule, fine-tuning (63,240 params, 3 seeds), SAE edit (removing 3 latents); three WSP information variants (flaw/target/physics-origin informed); control photon above threshold for generator/regression tests.
runs_and_variance: 3 independent runs per variant per model size, 3 edits per run; median and range reported: 'The same prompt gives edits whose remaining error differs by up to a factor of three, and whose size ranges from 142 to about 10,000 parameters.' (Sec 3.2)
robustness_of_edits: Edits built on W/QCD only transfer to all nine signal classes, to the generator head (median 0.2% mass change vs 1.1% original), and to a newly trained regression head; responses to particles down to 1 MeV stay flat but nonzero.
verification: none formal; held-out test jets; isolation audit of agent file access; authors state repairs do not make the tagger 'infrared safe in the formal sense'
memorization_vs_reasoning: Agents had to state expectations before each query and submit a pre-query edit; target-informed agents discovered the threshold by probing; 'None of the edits acts mainly on b7/6, the main reader' - agents add an upstream detector instead. Two runs saw other agents' process command lines (reported in Appendix C).
limitations_stated: Variation between runs ('one run is not enough to trust the method'); LLM 'not state of the art'; at most 50 queries; edits restricted to backbone and classifier; large-model edits up to 400,000 parameters; nonzero residual soft response.
code_or_data: https://github.com/rbonnetguerrini/WSP-mech-interp-for-model-editing-in-particle-physics ; Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.24377675 (edited weights, SAE checkpoints, jet sets, agent transcripts)
cites_or_builds_on: Takehi et al. 2026 Sparks of WSP [50]
notes_for_survey: Domain-science repair case with three-way comparison (WSP agent, SAE latent removal, fine-tuning) and an information-access ablation for the agent; edits evaluated on downstream heads not used to build them. Includes authors' note on misuse and self-modification risks.
